Arrest of a communist suspect - assistance to Zingkiang
Authorities

On October 11, 1936, the Municipal Police, at the
request of representatives of the Zingkiang Public Safety
Bureau, arrested a communist suspect who was alleged to
have escaped from the custody of the Chinese Authorities
on September 10, 1936. A quantity of books and periodicals
of a radical nature was later seized at his home.
The accused appeared on remand before the 2nd Branch
Kiangsu High Court on October 16 when he was extradited to
the Zingkiang authorities together with the seizure.

Zingkiang:- Reactionary makes escape from prison.

The publication edited by Zung Shee Yah (曾希俠),
age 20, a student in a school in Shanghai and who is the
son of the proprietor of the Zung Ling Kyi Pig Hong in
Hsing Kong Village, Zingkiang, was banned by the Kiangsu
Provincial Authorities at the request of the Zingkiang
P.S.B. because it had published articles denouncing
the Government. On Zung's return to Zingkiang from
Shanghai last month, he was placed under arrest by the
Special Service Officers of the Zingkiang Tanpu and was
detained by the P.S.B. At about 7 p.m. Sept. 13, he
scaled a wall and made good his escape. Prior to his
escape, he left a note in the Supt's Office read as
follows:-

"I am going out on an important engagement
and will be back in two hours' time. Please don't
get excited".

The Police are endeavouring to locate his
whereabouts.

靖江：反动分子越狱逃脱。

曾希侠（Zung Shee Yah，音译）编辑的出版物，曾希侠，20岁，上海某校学生，系靖江兴港村郑灵记猪行（Zung Ling Kyi Pig Hong，音译）店主之子，因刊登谴责政府的文章，应靖江公安局请求，被江苏省当局查禁。上月曾从上海返回靖江后，被靖江党部特务人员逮捕，并由公安局拘留。9月13日晚7时许，他翻墙成功逃脱。逃脱前，他在局长办公室留下一张纸条，内容如下：

郑希侠（Zung Shee Yah，音译），二区新港郑灵记猪行（Zung Ling Kee Pig Hong，音译）店主之子，上海光华大学学生，此前因在其自任编辑和出版人的上海《曙光》周刊上发表荒谬及反动文章，被靖江国民党总部特务人员逮捕。他被拘押在公安局，等待省当局的指示。9月13日晚7时许，囚犯翻墙逃脱。目前尚未重新逮捕。

Translation of extracts from Kyi Kwang Weekly,
issue No. 3, dated 28.6.36, edited and published
by Zung Shee Yah(鄭希俠) (in custody).

This periodical contains the following articles:-

(1) Editorial stating that the 3rd issue will be the
last issue as the publication has to be stopped
owing to "difficulties."

(2) Article entitled "Cries of the Weak and Minor
Races for Emancipation, and Our Way-Out," describing
briefly the sufferings of the weak and minor races
throughout the world and expressing the hope that
imperialism will eventually collapse in the face
of the emancipation movement of the oppressed.

(3) Drama written by Shee Yah (the accused) entitled
"National Salvation Literature: The Iron Torrent,
Parts 1 and 2," telling the story of a small party
of volunteers engaged in fighting against their enemies.
The greater part of the drama depicts the arrest and
execution of a traitor who is the uncle of one of the
leaders of the volunteer army, showing the people
that all traitors, irrespective of who they are, should
be annihilated. The following song is contained in
the second part:-

" Rise Up, all of us who are unwilling to become
slaves!
Build a new great wall with our blood and flesh
and warn our people of the approach of the most
critical moment.
Rise Up!       Rise Up!
Let all of us be singe-minded and advance in
the face of the enemies' gunfire. "

------

该期刊包含以下文章：

(1) 社论声明，由于“困难”，第3期将是最后一期，出版物必须停刊。

(2) 题为《弱小民族解放的呼声与我们的出路》的文章，简要描述了世界各地弱小民族的苦难，并表达了希望在被压迫者的解放运动面前，帝国主义最终会崩溃。

(3) 由希侠（被告）创作的戏剧，题为《救亡文学：铁流，第一部和第二部》，讲述了一小队志愿者与敌人作战的故事。戏剧的大部分描绘了一名志愿军领导人的叔叔——一名叛徒——的被捕和处决，向人们表明，所有叛徒，无论他们是谁，都应被消灭。第二部分包含以下歌曲：

用我们的血肉筑起新的长城，警告我们的人民最危急的时刻已经临近。
起来！       起来！
让我们万众一心，迎着敌人的炮火前进。”

My son was sent to the Hsien Public Safety

(? radical).

Woo Tse Tseng alias Zung Shee Yah
Zingkiang, Kiangsu D.SJ Jones
Louza Station Oct.11, 1936 Clerk Lee Dong-liang

My real name is Zung Shee Yah (鄭希俠), age
22. I was born in Shanghai and remained in this city until
4 years of age, when my father, who owns a company for the
transportation of pigs, took me to Zingkiang, his home and
main place of business.

Until I was 13 years of age, I studied under a private
tutor at home. From the age of 13 to 17 years, I studied at
the Nanching Middle School (南清中學) in Kiangyin (江陰).
I next attended the William College (婁雲), Sing Lung Hwa,
(新龍華), Shanghai. After a period of three years study
I graduated and left the college to attend the Kwang Hwa
(光華) University in Great Western Road (O.O.L.). I
studied art at this institution during the two years I spent
there and then left, in June last, owing to financial
considerations.

From the time of my leaving the Kwang Hwa University
until September 11, 1936, I stayed with my parents at
Zingkiang on holiday. I left Zingkiang on that date and
arrived in Shanghai the following day. The first two days
after arrival I put up at the Grand Hotel, Yu Ya Ching Road.
On September 14, I removed to my present address at No.146
Zung Tse Li (仁智里), North Szechmen Road. The reason
for my removing to this address was because I wished to be
near the General Post Office, where I hope to obtain a
position as clerk. I have already sent in the necessary
application form. My present room was formerly occupied
by my friend Woo Tse Tseng (胡之中), a former schoolmate.

老闸捕房 1936年10月11日 书记员 Lee Dong-liang

我的真名是 Zung Shee Yah (鄭希俠)，年龄
22岁。我出生于上海，并在这座城市生活到
4岁，当时拥有生猪运输公司的父亲带我去了他的家乡兼主要经商地靖江。

直到13岁，我一直在家跟随私人教师学习。从13岁到17岁，我在江阴的南清中學就读。
此后，我进入上海新龍華的 William College (婁雲) 就读。经过三年的学习，
我毕业离校，进入大西路的光華大学就读。
在该校学习的两年期间，我攻读艺术，后因经济
原因于去年六月离校。

从去年六月离开光華大学到1936年9月11日，
我一直在靖江父母家中度假。我于该日离开靖江，
次日抵达上海。抵达后的头两天，我住在亚尔培路的大华饭店。
9月14日，我搬至现址四川北路仁智里146号。
搬至此处的原因是我希望靠近邮政总局，以期在那里获得
一份书记员职位。我已提交必要的申请表。我现在的房间以前由我的朋友、前同学 Woo Tse Tseng (胡之中) 居住。

It was on his advice that I took over the room from him.
Since my arrival in Shanghai last September I have
been keeping a woman. In order that my parents should not
learn about this I assumed the name of Woo Tse Tsoeng, which
is actually that of my friend.
I am not a Communist, neither do I belong to any
political party.
In August this year I was arrested at Zingkiang for
publishing radical articles in magazine entitled "Yi Kwang"
(驥光), which I brought out in June. I was detained
for 33 days by the Public Safety Bureau in Zingkiang, and
was then released on security provided by my father.
It is untrue that I escaped from the custody of the
Public Safety Bureau.

(Signed) Zung Shee Yah

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13 1936

Student Faces
High Court On
Red Charges
Search Of Room Reveals
Communist Literature;
Case Is Remanded

Woo Tse-soong, student, age 22, who led the authorities a wild chase Sunday morning through the Sincere Department Store, wound up in the 2nd Kiangsu High Court yesterday confronted with a charge of being concerned in Communistic activities.

A Sikh police constable, standing on Nanking Road near Yu Yaching Road, saw two Bureau of Public Safety officers chasing Woo down the street. Sensing that something was amiss, he took up the chase, outstripped the two B.P.S. men and chased Woo into Sincere's.

After tumbling through a maze of shoppers and showcases, the constable finally collared Woo and handed him over to a Shanghai Municipal Police officer who took the fellow to the Louza Station. The Bureau of Public Safety officers extended their thanks to the Settlement police and appeared against the man in court yesterday.

They explained that the fellow was accused of being a reactionary and had given them a great deal of trouble of late and that he was wanted by the Chingkiang authorities. The man had escaped from jail in that city on September 10, they said, and they had been hot on his trail ever since.

Woo is still in the hands of the Settlement police, having been remanded in custody for another week pending the arrival of documentary evidence against him from Chingkiang. The man's Shanghai quarters were searched after his arrest and a quantity reactionary publications seized.

（印：I. PRA...）

学生因涉红罪
面临高等法院审讯
房间搜查发现
共产主义文献；
案件已还押候审

吴泽松（Woo Tse-soong，音译），22岁学生，于周日上午带领当局在先施百货公司展开了一场疯狂追逐，昨日在江苏高等第二分院出庭，被控参与共产主义活动。

一名锡克族巡捕站在南京路近虞洽卿路处，看见两名公安局警员在街上追捕吴。他察觉情况有异，便加入追捕，跑在那两名公安局人员前面，将吴追入先施公司。

在穿过迷宫般的顾客和展示柜后，该巡捕最终抓住了吴，并将其移交给一名上海公共租界工部局警务处警员，后者将该人带至老闸捕房。公安局警员对租界警方表示感谢，并于昨日在法庭上对该男子提出指控。

他们解释说，该人被指控为反动分子，最近给他们制造了许多麻烦，且镇江当局正在通缉他。他们称，该人于9月10日从该城市的监狱逃脱，此后他们一直紧追不舍。

吴目前仍由租界警方羁押，因等待镇江方面寄来针对他的书面证据，已被还押候审一周。该人在被捕后，其在上海的住所遭到搜查，查获了大量反动刊物。

（印：I. PRA...）
